description: Generated from infra/observability/grafana/definition by tools/grafana/dashboards.mjs: not edited here or in Grafana.

targets.rawSql:
-- Records, conformity and the IGCD by cut (decisions 0031 and 0057): the
-- last twelve cuts up to this one, oldest first.
SELECT cut, records, failures, conformity, igcd
  FROM (SELECT s.cut::text AS cut, s.records, round(s.igcd::numeric, 4) AS igcd,
               COALESCE(sum(r.failures), 0)::bigint AS failures,
               CASE WHEN sum(r.applies) > 0
                    THEN round(1 - sum(r.failures)::numeric / sum(r.applies), 4) END AS conformity
          FROM quality.run_summary s
          LEFT JOIN quality.rule_results r USING (tenant_id, dataset, cut)
         WHERE s.dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND s.cut <= (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
         GROUP BY s.cut, s.records, s.igcd
         ORDER BY s.cut DESC
         LIMIT 12) recent
 ORDER BY cut

-- Failures by dimension and severity (decision 0031): the cut's rules by
-- what they measure and how much a failure weighs.
SELECT dimension, severity, count(*) AS rules, sum(applies)::bigint AS applies,
       sum(failures)::bigint AS failures
  FROM quality.rule_results
 WHERE dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
 GROUP BY dimension, severity
 ORDER BY failures DESC, dimension NULLS LAST, severity NULLS LAST

-- Fields with the most failures (decision 0031): the cut's rules by field.
SELECT field, count(*) AS rules, sum(applies)::bigint AS applies,
       sum(failures)::bigint AS failures
  FROM quality.rule_results
 WHERE dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
 GROUP BY field
 ORDER BY failures DESC, field NULLS LAST

-- Fields with the lowest ICD in the cut (decision 0057): each field's mean
-- over the records where it has one, the lowest first.
SELECT field, round(mean_icd::numeric, 4) AS icd
  FROM quality.field_quality
 WHERE dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date AND mean_icd IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY mean_icd, field

panels.title: Distribution of the ICD by entity

targets.rawSql:
-- The entities' ICD in the cut (decision 0057), in bins of 0.05: how many
-- from 0.00, 0.05, … 0.95 (1.0 counts in the last).
SELECT round((least(floor(icd * 20), 19) / 20)::numeric, 2) AS from_icd, count(*) AS entities
  FROM quality.entity_icd
 WHERE dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date AND icd IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Data condition by segment

targets.rawSql:
-- The entities of each segment by band in the cut (decision 0057), the
-- largest segment first.
SELECT segment,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE band = 'high') AS high,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE band = 'medium') AS medium,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE band = 'low') AS low
  FROM quality.entity_icd
 WHERE dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date AND band IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY segment
 ORDER BY count(*) DESC, segment

panels.title: How entities moved between bands

targets.rawSql:
-- How the entities moved between bands from the previous cut to this one
-- (decision 0057), matched by their hash; none without a previous cut.
SELECT p.band AS from_band, c.band AS to_band, count(*) AS entities
  FROM quality.entity_icd c
  JOIN quality.entity_icd p
    ON p.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND p.dataset = c.dataset AND p.entity = c.entity
   AND p.cut = (NULLIF(${previous_cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
 WHERE c.dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND c.cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
   AND c.band IS NOT NULL AND p.band IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY 1, 2
 ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['high', 'medium', 'low'], p.band),
          array_position(ARRAY['high', 'medium', 'low'], c.band)

panels.title: SFC indicator

targets.rawSql:
-- The SFC view (decision 0058, the guide's formulas §4 and §5): each cell
-- with its share of active records right, whether it passes (90 %), its
-- missing and margin, its closeness to the threshold, and the dataset's
-- SFC, the share of its cells that pass. The highest share first.
SELECT cell, ok, total,
       round((ok::float8 / NULLIF(total, 0))::numeric, 4) AS p,
       passes, missing, margin,
       CASE
           WHEN total = 0 THEN NULL
           WHEN ok >= 0.92 * total THEN 0.2
           WHEN ok >= 0.90 * total THEN 0.5
           WHEN ok >= 0.80 * total THEN 1.0
           WHEN ok >= 0.70 * total THEN 0.6
           ELSE 0.3
       END AS closeness,
       round(avg(passes::int) OVER ()::numeric, 4) AS sfc
  FROM quality.cells
 WHERE dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
 ORDER BY ok::float8 / NULLIF(total, 0) DESC NULLS LAST, cell

panels.description: Each row is a cell: a field holding the sfc role, right when filled and no rule that reads it fails. It is 1 when at least 90% of the active records have it right. The band (80–90%) is where the fewest fixes turn a cell from 0 to 1. Shows data only for a dataset whose mapping gives its fields the roles `sfc`.

panels.title: p′ chart by group · ${dimension}

targets.rawSql:
-- p′ chart by group (decision 0031, the guide's formulas, Laney): per
-- dimension, each group's share of records with a serious failure against
-- the dimension's, with limits widened by the real spread between groups
-- (the moving range of z, groups by size). The empty group is left out.
WITH g AS (
    SELECT dimension, grp, records, serious, serious::float8 / records AS p
      FROM quality.group_metrics
     WHERE dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date AND grp <> '' AND records > 0),
pb AS (
    SELECT dimension, sum(serious)::float8 / sum(records) AS p_bar FROM g GROUP BY 1),
z AS (
    SELECT g.*, pb.p_bar, sqrt(pb.p_bar * (1 - pb.p_bar) / g.records) AS sigma
      FROM g JOIN pb USING (dimension)),
mr AS (
    SELECT *, abs(z - lag(z) OVER (PARTITION BY dimension ORDER BY records, grp)) AS mr
      FROM (SELECT *, (p - p_bar) / NULLIF(sigma, 0) AS z FROM z) zz),
sz AS (
    SELECT dimension, COALESCE(avg(mr) / 1.128, 1) AS sigma_z FROM mr GROUP BY 1),
l AS (
    SELECT mr.*, greatest(0, p_bar - 3 * sigma * sigma_z) AS lcl,
           least(1, p_bar + 3 * sigma * sigma_z) AS ucl
      FROM mr JOIN sz USING (dimension))
SELECT dimension, grp, records, serious, round(p::numeric, 4) AS p,
       round(p_bar::numeric, 4) AS p_bar, round(lcl::numeric, 4) AS lcl,
       round(ucl::numeric, 4) AS ucl,
       CASE WHEN p > ucl THEN 'above' WHEN p < lcl THEN 'below' ELSE 'in' END AS signal
  FROM l
 ORDER BY dimension, records DESC, grp

panels.description: Share of records with a serious failure (blocking or major in a critical or high field), by group size. The curves are the control limits. Shows data only for a dataset whose mapping gives its fields the roles `dimension`.

panels.title: Largest groups · ${dimension}

targets.rawSql:
-- Largest groups (decision 0031): per dimension, its fifteen groups with
-- the most records, each with its share of serious failures and its mean
-- ICD; the empty group too, as ''.
SELECT dimension, grp, records, serious,
       round((serious::float8 / NULLIF(records, 0))::numeric, 4) AS serious_share,
       round(mean_icd::numeric, 4) AS icd
  FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY dimension ORDER BY records DESC, grp) AS n
          FROM quality.group_metrics
         WHERE dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date) g
 WHERE n <= 15
 ORDER BY dimension, records DESC, grp

panels.description: Shows data only for a dataset whose mapping gives its fields the roles `dimension`.

panels.title: Groups that changed most · ${dimension}

targets.rawSql:
-- Groups that changed most (decision 0031): per dimension, the fifteen
-- groups whose share of serious failures moved most since the previous
-- cut, each in both; none without a previous cut.
SELECT dimension, grp, before, now, round((now - before)::numeric, 4) AS change
  FROM (SELECT c.dimension, c.grp,
               round((p.serious::float8 / p.records)::numeric, 4) AS before,
               round((c.serious::float8 / c.records)::numeric, 4) AS now,
               row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.dimension
                   ORDER BY abs(c.serious::float8 / c.records - p.serious::float8 / p.records) DESC,
                            c.grp) AS n
          FROM quality.group_metrics c
          JOIN quality.group_metrics p
            ON p.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND p.dataset = c.dataset
           AND p.dimension = c.dimension AND p.grp = c.grp AND p.cut = (NULLIF(${previous_cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
         WHERE c.dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND c.cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
           AND c.records > 0 AND p.records > 0) g
 WHERE n <= 15
 ORDER BY dimension, abs(now - before) DESC, grp

panels.title: Outliers by group · ${dimension}

targets.rawSql:
-- Outliers by group (decision 0031, the guide's formula 7): per dimension,
-- the fifteen groups with the most outliers of the outlier amount, robust
-- z beyond 3.5 within the group, each with its share; the empty group as ''.
SELECT variable, dimension, grp, records, low, high,
       round(((low + high)::float8 / NULLIF(records, 0))::numeric, 4) AS share
  FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY variable, dimension
                                         ORDER BY low + high DESC, records DESC, grp) AS n
          FROM quality.distribution_checks
         WHERE dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date AND dimension <> '') d
 WHERE n <= 15
 ORDER BY dimension, low + high DESC, records DESC, grp

panels.description: amounts whose robust z within their group is beyond 3.5, either way Shows data only for a dataset whose mapping gives its fields the roles `outlier_amount`, `dimension`.

panels.title: PSI by deciles · ${drift_variable}

targets.rawSql:
-- PSI by deciles (decision 0031, the guide's formula 8): per drift
-- variable, the previous cut's deciles as bins, each cut's share in them
-- read off its percentiles (to 1 %), and the PSI their sum; none without
-- a previous cut. Bins empty in both count with a floor of 0.0001.
WITH c AS (
    SELECT variable, percentiles AS cur FROM quality.distribution_checks
     WHERE dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date AND dimension = ''
       AND percentiles IS NOT NULL),
p AS (
    SELECT variable, percentiles AS prev FROM quality.distribution_checks
     WHERE dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND cut = (NULLIF(${previous_cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date AND dimension = ''
       AND percentiles IS NOT NULL),
f AS (
    SELECT c.variable, k,
           CASE WHEN k = 0 THEN 0 WHEN k = 10 THEN 1
                ELSE (SELECT greatest(count(*) - 1, 0) FROM unnest(c.cur) x
                       WHERE x <= p.prev[10 * k + 1]) / 100.0 END AS fa,
           CASE WHEN k = 0 THEN 0 WHEN k = 10 THEN 1
                ELSE (SELECT greatest(count(*) - 1, 0) FROM unnest(p.prev) x
                       WHERE x <= p.prev[10 * k + 1]) / 100.0 END AS fe
      FROM c JOIN p USING (variable), generate_series(0, 10) AS k),
b AS (
    SELECT variable, k,
           greatest(fe - lag(fe) OVER w, 0.0001) AS e,
           greatest(fa - lag(fa) OVER w, 0.0001) AS a
      FROM f WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY variable ORDER BY k))
SELECT variable, k AS decile, round(e, 4) AS base, round(a, 4) AS now,
       round(sum((a - e) * ln(a / e)) OVER (PARTITION BY variable), 4) AS psi
  FROM b
 WHERE k > 0
 ORDER BY variable, k

panels.description: PSI below 0.10: stable; 0.10 to 0.25: moderate drift; above 0.25: significant drift. Shows data only for a dataset whose mapping gives its fields the roles `drift`.

panels.title: Remediation queues · ${dimension}

targets.rawSql:
-- Remediation queues (decision 0059): per dimension, its fifteen queues
-- with the most open findings at the cut, each with those overdue by its
-- SLA (its group's, else its dimension's, else 30 days), those resolved
-- at the cut, its oldest open finding's age in days since the cut it
-- opened at, and the open ones' summed priority; the empty group as ''.
SELECT dimension, grp, open, overdue, resolved, oldest_days, sla_days,
       round(priority::numeric, 4) AS priority
  FROM (SELECT q.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY dimension ORDER BY open DESC, grp) AS n
          FROM (SELECT f.dimension, f.grp,
                       sum(f.open)::bigint AS open,
                       coalesce(sum(f.open) FILTER (
                           WHERE f.since + coalesce(g.days, d.days, 30) < (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date), 0)::bigint
                           AS overdue,
                       sum(f.resolved)::bigint AS resolved,
                       max((NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date - f.since) FILTER (WHERE f.open > 0) AS oldest_days,
                       coalesce(max(g.days), max(d.days), 30) AS sla_days,
                       sum(f.priority) AS priority
                  FROM quality.queue_findings f
                  LEFT JOIN quality.remediation_slas g
                    ON g.tenant_id = f.tenant_id AND g.dataset = f.dataset
                   AND g.dimension = f.dimension AND g.grp = f.grp
                  LEFT JOIN quality.remediation_slas d
                    ON d.tenant_id = f.tenant_id AND d.dataset = f.dataset
                   AND d.dimension = f.dimension AND d.grp IS NULL
                 WHERE f.dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND f.cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
                 GROUP BY f.dimension, f.grp) q) r
 WHERE n <= 15
 ORDER BY dimension, open DESC, grp

panels.description: Open findings in each group's queue and those past its SLA, counted in days from the cut where each first failed. Shows data only for a dataset whose mapping gives its fields the roles `dimension`.

panels.title: Update recency

targets.rawSql:
-- Update recency (decision 0031): the records of the cut by the age of its
-- `updated` field at the cut, in its bands, the empty ones last.
SELECT r.band, r.records
  FROM quality.field_quality f,
       LATERAL (SELECT 'b' || o AS band, n AS records, o
                  FROM unnest(f.recency) WITH ORDINALITY AS u (n, o)
                UNION ALL
                SELECT 'empty', f.empty, 99) r
 WHERE f.dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND f.cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date AND f.recency IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY r.o

panels.description: Shows data only for a dataset whose mapping gives its fields the roles `updated`.

panels.title: Time per stage

targets.rawSql:
-- Time per stage (decision 0031, the run log of 0026): how long each stage
-- of the cut's evaluation took, in the order it ran, and its milliseconds
-- per million record-attributes (the guide's formula 9, V = records ×
-- mapped fields), the previous cut's beside it; no rate without a volume.
WITH volume AS (
    SELECT s.cut, s.records * count(f.field) AS v
      FROM quality.run_summary s
      LEFT JOIN quality.field_quality f
        ON f.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND f.dataset = s.dataset AND f.cut = s.cut
     WHERE s.dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND s.cut IN ((NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date, (NULLIF(${previous_cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date)
     GROUP BY s.cut, s.records
), times AS (
    SELECT j.cut, j.stage, j.position, j.ms,
           CASE WHEN v.v > 0 THEN round(j.ms * 1e6 / v.v, 2) END AS per_million
      FROM quality.job_stats j
      JOIN volume v ON v.cut = j.cut
     WHERE j.dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text)
)
SELECT c.stage, c.ms, c.per_million,
       p.ms AS previous_ms, p.per_million AS previous_per_million
  FROM times c
  LEFT JOIN times p ON p.stage = c.stage AND p.cut = (NULLIF(${previous_cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
 WHERE c.cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
 ORDER BY c.position

matcher.options: ms per million (ms when the cut has no volume)

targets.rawSql:
-- Profiling (decision 0031): each field of the cut, the emptiest first,
-- with its distinct values and its commonest shape's share.
SELECT f.field, s.records, f.empty,
       CASE WHEN s.records > 0 THEN round(f.empty::numeric / s.records, 4) END AS empty_share,
       f.distinct_values, f.pattern, f.floating,
       CASE WHEN s.records > f.empty
            THEN round(f.pattern_count::numeric / (s.records - f.empty), 4) END AS pattern_share
  FROM quality.field_quality f
  JOIN quality.run_summary s USING (tenant_id, dataset, cut)
 WHERE f.dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND f.cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
 ORDER BY empty_share DESC NULLS LAST, f.field

-- Conformity by rule (decision 0031): each rule of the cut, the worst first.
SELECT rule, field, dimension, severity, applies, failures,
       CASE WHEN applies > 0 THEN round(1 - failures::numeric / applies, 4) END AS conformity
  FROM quality.rule_results
 WHERE dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
 ORDER BY conformity NULLS LAST, rule

-- cut, each in both; none without a previous cut.

  FROM (SELECT c.dimension, c.grp,

                            c.grp) AS n
          FROM quality.group_metrics c
          JOIN quality.group_metrics p
            ON p.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND p.dataset = c.dataset
           AND p.dimension = c.dimension AND p.grp = c.grp AND p.cut = (NULLIF(${previous_cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
         WHERE c.dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND c.cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
           AND c.records > 0 AND p.records > 0) g
 WHERE n <= 15
 ORDER BY dimension, abs(now - before) DESC, grp

panels.description: Shows data only for a dataset whose mapping gives its fields the roles `dimension`.

panels.title: Outliers by group

targets.rawSql:
-- Outliers by group (decision 0031, the guide's formula 7): per dimension,
-- the fifteen groups with the most outliers of the outlier amount, robust
-- z beyond 3.5 within the group, each with its share; the empty group as ''.
SELECT variable, dimension, grp, records, low, high,
       round(((low + high)::float8 / NULLIF(records, 0))::numeric, 4) AS share
  FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY variable, dimension
                                         ORDER BY low + high DESC, records DESC, grp) AS n
          FROM quality.distribution_checks
         WHERE dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date AND dimension <> '') d
 WHERE n <= 15
 ORDER BY dimension, low + high DESC, records DESC, grp

panels.description: Shows data only for a dataset whose mapping gives its fields the roles `outlier_amount`, `dimension`.

panels.title: PSI by deciles

targets.rawSql:
-- PSI by deciles (decision 0031, the guide's formula 8): per drift
-- variable, the previous cut's deciles as bins, each cut's share in them
-- read off its percentiles (to 1 %), and the PSI their sum; none without
-- a previous cut. Bins empty in both count with a floor of 0.0001.
WITH c AS (
    SELECT variable, percentiles AS cur FROM quality.distribution_checks
     WHERE dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date AND dimension = ''
       AND percentiles IS NOT NULL),
p AS (
    SELECT variable, percentiles AS prev FROM quality.distribution_checks
     WHERE dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND cut = (NULLIF(${previous_cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date AND dimension = ''
       AND percentiles IS NOT NULL),
f AS (
    SELECT c.variable, k,
           CASE WHEN k = 0 THEN 0 WHEN k = 10 THEN 1
                ELSE (SELECT greatest(count(*) - 1, 0) FROM unnest(c.cur) x
                       WHERE x <= p.prev[10 * k + 1]) / 100.0 END AS fa,
           CASE WHEN k = 0 THEN 0 WHEN k = 10 THEN 1
                ELSE (SELECT greatest(count(*) - 1, 0) FROM unnest(p.prev) x
                       WHERE x <= p.prev[10 * k + 1]) / 100.0 END AS fe
      FROM c JOIN p USING (variable), generate_series(0, 10) AS k),
b AS (
    SELECT variable, k,
           greatest(fe - lag(fe) OVER w, 0.0001) AS e,
           greatest(fa - lag(fa) OVER w, 0.0001) AS a
      FROM f WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY variable ORDER BY k))
SELECT variable, k AS decile, round(e, 4) AS base, round(a, 4) AS now,
       round(sum((a - e) * ln(a / e)) OVER (PARTITION BY variable), 4) AS psi
  FROM b
 WHERE k > 0
 ORDER BY variable, k

panels.description: Shows data only for a dataset whose mapping gives its fields the roles `drift`.

panels.title: Remediation queues

targets.rawSql:
-- Remediation queues (decision 0059): per dimension, its fifteen queues
-- with the most open findings at the cut, each with those overdue by its
-- SLA (its group's, else its dimension's, else 30 days), those resolved
-- at the cut, its oldest open finding's age in days since the cut it
-- opened at, and the open ones' summed priority; the empty group as ''.
SELECT dimension, grp, open, overdue, resolved, oldest_days, sla_days,
       round(priority::numeric, 4) AS priority
  FROM (SELECT q.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY dimension ORDER BY open DESC, grp) AS n
          FROM (SELECT f.dimension, f.grp,
                       sum(f.open)::bigint AS open,
                       coalesce(sum(f.open) FILTER (
                           WHERE f.since + coalesce(g.days, d.days, 30) < (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date), 0)::bigint
                           AS overdue,
                       sum(f.resolved)::bigint AS resolved,
                       max((NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date - f.since) FILTER (WHERE f.open > 0) AS oldest_days,
                       coalesce(max(g.days), max(d.days), 30) AS sla_days,
                       sum(f.priority) AS priority
                  FROM quality.queue_findings f
                  LEFT JOIN quality.remediation_slas g
                    ON g.tenant_id = f.tenant_id AND g.dataset = f.dataset
                   AND g.dimension = f.dimension AND g.grp = f.grp
                  LEFT JOIN quality.remediation_slas d
                    ON d.tenant_id = f.tenant_id AND d.dataset = f.dataset
                   AND d.dimension = f.dimension AND d.grp IS NULL
                 WHERE f.dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND f.cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
                 GROUP BY f.dimension, f.grp) q) r
 WHERE n <= 15
 ORDER BY dimension, open DESC, grp

panels.description: Shows data only for a dataset whose mapping gives its fields the roles `dimension`.

panels.title: Update recency

targets.rawSql:
-- Update recency (decision 0031): the records of the cut by the age of its
-- `updated` field at the cut, in its bands, the empty ones last.
SELECT r.band, r.records
  FROM quality.field_quality f,
       LATERAL (SELECT 'b' || o AS band, n AS records, o
                  FROM unnest(f.recency) WITH ORDINALITY AS u (n, o)
                UNION ALL
                SELECT 'empty', f.empty, 99) r
 WHERE f.dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND f.cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date AND f.recency IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY r.o

panels.description: Shows data only for a dataset whose mapping gives its fields the roles `updated`.

targets.rawSql:
-- Time per stage (decision 0031, the run log of 0026): how long each stage
-- of the cut's evaluation took, in the order it ran, and its milliseconds
-- per million record-attributes (the guide's formula 9, V = records ×
-- mapped fields), the previous cut's beside it; no rate without a volume.
WITH volume AS (
    SELECT s.cut, s.records * count(f.field) AS v
      FROM quality.run_summary s
      LEFT JOIN quality.field_quality f
        ON f.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND f.dataset = s.dataset AND f.cut = s.cut
     WHERE s.dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND s.cut IN ((NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date, (NULLIF(${previous_cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date)
     GROUP BY s.cut, s.records
), times AS (
    SELECT j.cut, j.stage, j.position, j.ms,
           CASE WHEN v.v > 0 THEN round(j.ms * 1e6 / v.v, 2) END AS per_million
      FROM quality.job_stats j
      JOIN volume v ON v.cut = j.cut
     WHERE j.dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text)
)
SELECT c.stage, c.ms, c.per_million,
       p.ms AS previous_ms, p.per_million AS previous_per_million
  FROM times c
  LEFT JOIN times p ON p.stage = c.stage AND p.cut = (NULLIF(${previous_cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
 WHERE c.cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
 ORDER BY c.position

-- Profiling (decision 0031): each field of the cut, the emptiest first,
-- with its distinct values and its commonest shape's share.
SELECT f.field, s.records, f.empty,
       CASE WHEN s.records > 0 THEN round(f.empty::numeric / s.records, 4) END AS empty_share,
       f.distinct_values, f.pattern, f.floating,
       CASE WHEN s.records > f.empty
            THEN round(f.pattern_count::numeric / (s.records - f.empty), 4) END AS pattern_share
  FROM quality.field_quality f
  JOIN quality.run_summary s USING (tenant_id, dataset, cut)
 WHERE f.dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND f.cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
 ORDER BY empty_share DESC NULLS LAST, f.field

-- Conformity by rule (decision 0031): each rule of the cut, the worst first.
SELECT rule, field, dimension, severity, applies, failures,
       CASE WHEN applies > 0 THEN round(1 - failures::numeric / applies, 4) END AS conformity
  FROM quality.rule_results
 WHERE dataset = (NULLIF(${dataset:sqlstring}, '')::text) AND cut = (NULLIF(${cut:sqlstring}, '')::text)::date
 ORDER BY conformity NULLS LAST, rule
